:::{#def-conditional-kolmogorov-complexity}
#### Conditional Kolmogorov complexity

Let the universal computer $U$ of @def-kolmogorov-complexity
also receive an integer $n$ as an input,
so that it outputs $U(p, n)$ if it halts on program $p$.
Assume that, for each fixed $n$,
no program on which $U$ halts is a proper prefix of another.
The **conditional Kolmogorov complexity** of a binary string $x$ given $n$ is

$$\ckolmf{x}{n} \eqdef \min \set{\strlen{p} : U(p, n) = x}.$$

@cover2006elements [section 14.2] define it the same way.

:::
